# MyBlessings

> A giving platform where every donation becomes a blessing for someone in need.

MyBlessings connects people who want to help with people who need support — transparently, with every dollar tracked and every story honored.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Give With Purpose. Receive Blessings.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Three steps from generosity to impact.
- [About MyBlessings](/about-myblessings): Our mission and how kindness travels through the platform.
- [Give a Blessing](/give): Browse active campaigns and donate securely.
- [Configure a Blessing](/give-a-blessing): Sponsor someone with a custom blessing.
- [Request a Blessing (BlessME)](/request-help): Share what you need and connect with sponsors.
- [Explore Blessings](/explore-blessings): Browse blessings across every assistance category.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Live feed of active blessings.
- [Impact Map](/impact-map): See where blessings are landing across the world.
- [Categories](/categories): Discover causes by category.
- [Transparency](/transparency): Every blessing tracked, every dollar accounted for.
- [For NGOs](/ngo): Apply to receive blessings for your cause.
- [Become a Sponsor](/become-blessing-sponsor): Sign up to help connect those in need with support.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Sign in to your dashboard.
